content.title: LPL Financial Earnings Beat Estimates. Client Assets Surge 36%.
content.summary: LPL Financial  reported fourth-quarter earnings that handily beat Wall Street estimates thanks to lower expenses and a surge in fee-based revenue.  Executives also reiterated that they are track to meet retention goals following the company’s acquisition of Commonwealth Financial Network.  LPL posted adjusted earnings of $5.23 compared to analyst expectations of $4.92 per share.

content.title: LPL Financial (NASDAQ:LPLA) Surprises With Q4 CY2025 Sales

content.title: LPL’s Linsco Recruits $2 Billion Advisory Team From Fifth Third Private Bank
content.summary: LPL Financial  has recruited a $2 billion advisory team in Ohio from Fifth Third Private Bank.  Breanne Bovara and Derrick Petry are joining Linsco by LPL, the firm’s channel for independent advisors who are W-2 employees.  The team has offices in Cincinnati and Dayton and will operate under the name Moto Wealth Partners.
